Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifier as chembl_id, compound name, and canonical SMILES for compounds reported in the specified document. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Filter by document ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5728711. Left join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
